   150	                                   + static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZTile;
   151	         tileBegin <= lastZ; tileBegin += zStride) {
   152	        const std::size_t tileEnd = min(tileBegin + kZTile - 1, lastZ);
   153	        std::size_t index = tileBegin * plane + rowOffset;
   154	        Real bottom = input[index - plane];
   155	        Real center = input[index];
   156	
   157	        for (std::size_t z = tileBegin; z <= tileEnd; ++z) {
   158	            const Real top = input[index + plane];
   159	            tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 1] = center;
   160	
   161	            if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
   162	                tile[threadIdx.y + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
   163	            }
   164	            if (threadIdx.x == kBlockX - 1) {
   165	                const std::size_t rightX = min(rawX + 1, nx - 1);
   166	                tile[threadIdx.y + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
   167	                    input[z * plane + y * nx + rightX];
   168	            }
   169	            if (threadIdx.y == 0) {
   170	                tile[0][threadIdx.x + 1] = input[index - nx];
   171	            }
   172	            if (threadIdx.y == kBlockY - 1) {
   173	                const std::size_t backY = min(rawY + 1, ny - 1);
   174	                tile[kBlockY + 1][threadIdx.x + 1] =
   175	                    input[z * plane + backY * nx + x];
   176	            }
   177	            __syncthreads();
   178	
   179	            if (active) {
   180	                const Real left = tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x];
   181	                const Real right = tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 2];
   182	                const Real front = tile[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x + 1];
   183	                const Real back = tile[threadIdx.y + 2][threadIdx.x + 1];
   184	                output[index] =
   185	                    (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
   186	            }
   187	            __syncthreads();
   188	
   189	            bottom = center;
   190	            center = top;
   191	            index += plane;
   192	        }
   193	    }
   194	}
   195	
   196	void launchStencil(const Real* input, Real* output,
   197	                   const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
   198	                   const std::size_t firstZ, const std::size_t lastZ,
   199	                   cudaStream_t stream) {
   200	    if (firstZ > lastZ) {
   201	        return;
   202	    }
   203	
   204	    const std::size_t zTiles = (lastZ - firstZ + kZTile) / kZTile;
   205	    const unsigned int gridZ = static_cast<unsigned int>(
   206	        std::min<std::size_t>(zTiles, 65535));
   207	    const dim3 block(kBlockX, kBlockY, 1);
   208	    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX),
   209	                    static_cast<unsigned int>((ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY),
   210	                    gridZ);
   211	    stencilRange<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(input, output, nx, ny,
   212	                                             firstZ, lastZ);
   213	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   214	}
   215	
   216	void printUsage(const char* program) {
   217	    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", program);
   218	    std::printf("Options:\n");
   219	    std::printf("  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\n");
   220	    std::printf("  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\n");
   320	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(localComm, &localSize));
   321	
   322	    int deviceCount = 0;
   323	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
   324	    if (deviceCount <= 0) {
   325	        abortRun("no CUDA device is visible");
   326	    }
   327	    const int device = localRank % deviceCount;
   328	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
   329	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
   330	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSetSharedMemConfig(cudaSharedMemBankSizeEightByte));
   331	
   332	    cudaDeviceProp deviceProperties{};
   333	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&deviceProperties, device));
   334	    if (localRank == 0 && localSize > deviceCount) {
   335	        std::fprintf(stderr,
   336	                     "Warning: %d local MPI ranks share %d CUDA device(s); "
   337	                     "one rank per GPU is recommended.\n",
   338	                     localSize, deviceCount);
   339	    }
   340	
   341	    // Open MPI exposes a runtime query for CUDA-aware buffer support.  Use
   342	    // device buffers directly when every rank supports it; pinned staging is
   343	    // the portable fallback for MPI implementations without that extension.
   344	    int localCudaAware = 0;
   345	#if defined(OMPI_HAVE_MPI_EXT_CUDA)
   346	    localCudaAware = MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
   347	#endif
   348	    int cudaAware = 0;
   349	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localCudaAware, &cudaAware, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN,
   350	                            MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   351	
   352	    omp_set_dynamic(0);
   353	    const Slab slab = slabForRank(nz, worldRank, worldSize);
   354	    std::size_t localElements = 0;
   355	    std::size_t allocationElements = 0;
   356	    if (!checkedMultiply(slab.planes, planeElements, localElements) ||
   357	        !checkedMultiply(slab.planes + 2, planeElements, allocationElements) ||
   358	        allocationElements > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() / sizeof(Real)) {
   359	        abortRun("local grid allocation size overflow");
   360	    }
   361	    const std::size_t allocationBytes = allocationElements * sizeof(Real);
   362	    const std::size_t localBytes = localElements * sizeof(Real);
   363	    const std::size_t planeBytes = planeElements * sizeof(Real);
   364	
   365	    if (worldRank == 0) {
   366	        std::printf("3D Stencil Benchmark\n");
   367	        std::printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", nx, ny, nz);
   368	        std::printf("Iterations: %d\n", iterations);
   369	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   370	        std::printf("Parallel configuration: %d MPI rank(s), up to %d OpenMP "
   371	                    "thread(s)/rank, CUDA GPU(s) (%s on rank 0)\n",
   372	                    worldSize, omp_get_max_threads(), deviceProperties.name);
   373	        std::printf("MPI halo transport: %s\n",
   374	                    cudaAware ? "CUDA-aware device buffers" :
   375	                                "portable pinned-host buffers");
   376	        std::printf("Initializing grid...\n");
   377	    }
   378	
   379	    std::vector<Real> hostLocal(localElements);
   380	    const std::size_t globalOffset = slab.globalBegin * planeElements;
   381	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   382	    for (long long i = 0; i < static_cast<long long>(localElements); ++i) {
   383	        const std::size_t localIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(i);
   384	        hostLocal[localIndex] = static_cast<Real>((globalOffset + localIndex) % 19);
   385	    }
   386	
   387	    Real* deviceA = nullptr;
   388	    Real* deviceB = nullptr;
   389	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceA), allocationBytes));
   390	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceB), allocationBytes));
   391	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(deviceA, 0, allocationBytes));
   392	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(deviceB, 0, allocationBytes));
   393	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(deviceA + planeElements, hostLocal.data(), localBytes,
   394	                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   395	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(deviceB + planeElements, hostLocal.data(), localBytes,
   396	                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   397	
   398	    Real* sendLower = nullptr;
   399	    Real* sendUpper = nullptr;
   400	    Real* recvLower = nullptr;
   401	    Real* recvUpper = nullptr;
   402	    if (!cudaAware) {
   403	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&sendLower), planeBytes));
   404	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&sendUpper), planeBytes));
   405	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&recvLower), planeBytes));
   406	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&recvUpper), planeBytes));
   407	    }
   408	
   409	    cudaStream_t computeStream{};
   410	    cudaStream_t communicationStream{};
   411	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&computeStream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   412	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&communicationStream,
   413	                                         cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   414	    cudaEvent_t haloReady{};
   415	    cudaEvent_t iterationDone[2]{};
   416	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&haloReady, cudaEventDisableTiming));
   417	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&iterationDone[0], cudaEventDisableTiming));
   418	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&iterationDone[1], cudaEventDisableTiming));
   419	
   420	    const int lowerRank = worldRank == 0 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : worldRank - 1;
   421	    const int upperRank = worldRank + 1 == worldSize ? MPI_PROC_NULL : worldRank + 1;
   422	    const int planeCount = static_cast<int>(planeElements);
   423	
   424	    // Convert global interior z bounds to local indices.  Local owned planes
   425	    // are numbered [1, slab.planes], with receive halos at 0 and planes + 1.
   426	    const std::size_t validBegin = std::max<std::size_t>(
   427	        1, slab.globalBegin == 0 ? 2 : 1);
   428	    const std::size_t validEnd = std::min<std::size_t>(
   429	        slab.planes, nz - 1 - slab.globalBegin);
   430	    const std::size_t independentBegin = std::max<std::size_t>(validBegin, 2);
   431	    const std::size_t independentEnd = slab.planes > 1
   432	        ? std::min<std::size_t>(validEnd, slab.planes - 1) : 0;
   433	
   434	    if (worldRank == 0) {
   435	        std::printf("Running stencil computation...\n");
   436	    }
   437	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   438	    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
   439	
   440	    Real* input = deviceA;
   441	    Real* output = deviceB;
   442	    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < iterations; ++iteration) {
   443	        MPI_Request requests[4]{};
   444	        Real* const lowerReceive = cudaAware ? input : recvLower;
   445	        Real* const upperReceive = cudaAware
   446	            ? input + (slab.planes + 1) * planeElements : recvUpper;
   447	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(lowerReceive, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, lowerRank,
   448	                            kUpperTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[0]));
   449	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(upperReceive, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, upperRank,
   450	                            kLowerTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[1]));
   451	
   452	        // These planes depend only on locally owned data and run while halo
   453	        // copies and MPI transfers progress.
   454	        if (independentBegin <= independentEnd) {
   455	            launchStencil(input, output, nx, ny, independentBegin,
   456	                          independentEnd, computeStream);
   457	        }
   458	
   459	        if (cudaAware) {
   460	            // The previous edge kernels produced the outgoing device faces.
   461	            // Interior work for this iteration has already been queued and can
   462	            // overlap the MPI transfer once that event becomes ready.
   463	            if (iteration != 0) {
   464	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(
   465	                    iterationDone[(iteration - 1) & 1]));
   466	            }
   467	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(input + planeElements, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE,
   468	                                lowerRank, kLowerTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   469	                                &requests[2]));
   470	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(input + slab.planes * planeElements,
   471	                                planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, upperRank, kUpperTag,
   472	                                MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[3]));
   473	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(4, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
   474	        } else {
   475	            if (iteration != 0) {
   476	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(
   477	                    communicationStream, iterationDone[(iteration - 1) & 1], 0));
   478	            }
   479	            if (lowerRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   480	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(sendLower, input + planeElements,
   481	                                           planeBytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
   482	                                           communicationStream));
   483	            }
   484	            if (upperRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   485	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(sendUpper,
   486	                                           input + slab.planes * planeElements,
   487	                                           planeBytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
   488	                                           communicationStream));
   489	            }
   490	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(communicationStream));
   491	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(sendLower, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, lowerRank,
   492	                                kLowerTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[2]));
   493	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(sendUpper, planeCount, MPI_DOUBLE, upperRank,
   494	                                kUpperTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[3]));
   495	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(4, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
   496	
   497	            if (lowerRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   498	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(input, recvLower, planeBytes,
   499	                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
   500	                                           communicationStream));
   501	            }
   502	            if (upperRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   503	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(
   504	                    input + (slab.planes + 1) * planeElements, recvUpper,
   505	                    planeBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, communicationStream));
   506	            }
   507	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(haloReady, communicationStream));
   508	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(computeStream, haloReady, 0));
   509	        }
   510	
   511	        // The first and last owned planes consume the newly received halos.
   512	        if (validBegin == 1 && validBegin <= validEnd) {
   513	            launchStencil(input, output, nx, ny, 1, 1, computeStream);
   514	        }
   515	        if (validEnd == slab.planes && slab.planes != 1 &&
   516	            validBegin <= validEnd) {
   517	            launchStencil(input, output, nx, ny, slab.planes, slab.planes,
   518	                          computeStream);
   519	        }
   520	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(iterationDone[iteration & 1], computeStream));
   521	        std::swap(input, output);
   522	    }
   523	
   524	    if (iterations > 0) {
   525	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(iterationDone[(iterations - 1) & 1]));
   526	    }
   527	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   528	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   529	    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
   530	    double elapsed = 0.0;
   531	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0,
   532	                         MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   533	
   534	    if (worldRank == 0) {
   535	        std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", elapsed * 1000.0);
   536	        const double updates = static_cast<double>(nx - 2) *
   537	                               static_cast<double>(ny - 2) *
   538	                               static_cast<double>(nz - 2) * iterations;
   539	        const double mcups = elapsed > 0.0 ? updates / elapsed / 1.0e6 : 0.0;
   540	        std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
   560	                const Slab rankSlab = slabForRank(nz, rank, worldSize);
   561	                counts[rank] = static_cast<int>(rankSlab.planes * planeElements);
   562	                displacements[rank] =
   563	                    static_cast<int>(rankSlab.globalBegin * planeElements);
   564	            }
   565	        }
   566	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(hostLocal.data(), static_cast<int>(localElements),
   567	                              MPI_DOUBLE, finalGrid.data(), counts.data(),
   568	                              displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
   569	                              MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   570	        if (worldRank == 0) {
   571	            print_results(finalGrid, "Grid");
   572	        }
   573	    }
   574	
   575	    int returnCode = 0;
   576	    if (validate) {
   577	        Real localMin = std::numeric_limits<Real>::infinity();
   578	        Real localMax = -std::numeric_limits<Real>::infinity();
   579	        int localInvalid = 0;
   580	#pragma omp parallel for reduction(min:localMin) reduction(max:localMax) \
   581	                         reduction(|:localInvalid) schedule(static)
   582	        for (long long i = 0; i < static_cast<long long>(localElements); ++i) {
   583	            const Real value = hostLocal[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
   584	            localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
   585	            localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
   586	            localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
   587	        }
   588	
   589	        Real globalMin = 0.0;
   590	        Real globalMax = 0.0;
   591	        int globalInvalid = 0;
   592	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, 0,
   593	                             MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   594	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0,
   595	                             MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   596	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX,
   597	                             0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   598	        if (worldRank == 0) {
   599	            std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   600	            if (globalInvalid != 0) {
   601	                std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
   602	            }
   603	            std::printf("Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
   604	            const bool valid = globalInvalid == 0 && globalMax <= 1.0e6 &&
   605	                               globalMin >= -1.0e6;
   606	            if (!valid && globalInvalid == 0) {
   607	                std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
   608	            }
   609	            std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
   610	            returnCode = valid ? 0 : 1;
   611	        }
   612	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&returnCode, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   613	    }
   614	
   615	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(iterationDone[1]));
   616	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(iterationDone[0]));
   617	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(haloReady));
   618	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(communicationStream));
   619	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(computeStream));
   620	    if (!cudaAware) {
   621	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(recvUpper));
   622	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(recvLower));
   623	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(sendUpper));
   624	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(sendLower));
   625	    }
   626	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceB));
   627	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceA));
   628	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&localComm));
   629	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
   630	    return returnCode;
   631	}

+bool checkedMultiply(const std::size_t a, const std::size_t b,
+                     std::size_t& result) {
+    if (a != 0 && b > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() / a) {
+        return false;
     }
+    result = a * b;
+    return true;

+struct Slab {
+    std::size_t globalBegin;
+    std::size_t planes;
+};
+
+Slab slabForRank(const std::size_t nz, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t rankCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    const std::size_t base = nz / rankCount;
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    const std::size_t rankIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    return {
+        rankIndex * base + std::min(rankIndex, remainder),
+        base + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1U : 0U)
+    };
 }
 
+// Each CUDA block owns an x/y tile and up to kZTile consecutive planes.  The
+// z loop retains bottom/center values in registers, while the current x/y
+// plane is shared by the block.  This reduces the steady-state global-memory
+// traffic to approximately one load and one store per cell update.
+__global__ void stencilRange(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                             Real* __restrict__ output,
+                             const std::size_t nx,
+                             const std::size_t ny,
+                             const std::size_t firstZ,
+                             const std::size_t lastZ) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const std::size_t rawX = 1 + static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX
+                           + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t rawY = 1 + static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY
+                           + threadIdx.y;
+    const std::size_t x = min(rawX, nx - 1);
+    const std::size_t y = min(rawY, ny - 1);
+    const bool active = rawX < nx - 1 && rawY < ny - 1;
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t rowOffset = y * nx + x;
+
+    const std::size_t zStride = static_cast<std::size_t>(gridDim.z) * kZTile;
+    for (std::size_t tileBegin = firstZ
+                                   + static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZTile;
+         tileBegin <= lastZ; tileBegin += zStride) {
+        const std::size_t tileEnd = min(tileBegin + kZTile - 1, lastZ);
+        std::size_t index = tileBegin * plane + rowOffset;
+        Real bottom = input[index - plane];
+        Real center = input[index];
+
+        for (std::size_t z = tileBegin; z <= tileEnd; ++z) {
+            const Real top = input[index + plane];
+            tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 1] = center;
+
+            if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+                tile[threadIdx.y + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+            }
+            if (threadIdx.x == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const std::size_t rightX = min(rawX + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[threadIdx.y + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[z * plane + y * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (threadIdx.y == 0) {
+                tile[0][threadIdx.x + 1] = input[index - nx];
+            }
+            if (threadIdx.y == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const std::size_t backY = min(rawY + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[kBlockY + 1][threadIdx.x + 1] =
+                    input[z * plane + backY * nx + x];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            if (active) {
+                const Real left = tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x];
+                const Real right = tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 2];
+                const Real front = tile[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x + 1];
+                const Real back = tile[threadIdx.y + 2][threadIdx.x + 1];
+                output[index] =
+                    (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            index += plane;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+void launchStencil(const Real* input, Real* output,
+                   const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                   const std::size_t firstZ, const std::size_t lastZ,
+                   cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (firstZ > lastZ) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t zTiles = (lastZ - firstZ + kZTile) / kZTile;
+    const unsigned int gridZ = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+        std::min<std::size_t>(zTiles, 65535));
+    const dim3 block(kBlockX, kBlockY, 1);
+    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY),
+                    gridZ);
+    stencilRange<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(input, output, nx, ny,
+                                             firstZ, lastZ);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+}

+                                           input + slab.planes * planeElements,

Implemented the hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA stencil without adding source files or changing the `stencil3d` executable name.

Key changes:

- MPI z-slab decomposition with halo exchange.
- CUDA shared-memory tiled stencil with z-axis register reuse.
- Overlapped GPU computation and MPI communication using streams/events.
- Automatic CUDA-aware MPI device transfers when supported; pinned-host fallback otherwise.
- OpenMP-parallel initialization and validation.
- Distributed result gathering with equivalent boundary semantics.
- Required MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA configuration plus optimized GPU architectures in [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/stencil3d_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_hybrid_r4/stencil3d/CMakeLists.txt).

-void printUsage(const char* progName) {

+struct Slab {
+    std::size_t globalBegin;
+    std::size_t planes;
+};
+
+Slab slabForRank(const std::size_t nz, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t rankCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    const std::size_t base = nz / rankCount;
+    const std::size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    const std::size_t rankIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    return {
+        rankIndex * base + std::min(rankIndex, remainder),
+        base + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1U : 0U)
+    };
 }
 
+// Each CUDA block owns an x/y tile and up to kZTile consecutive planes.  The
+// z loop retains bottom/center values in registers, while the current x/y
+// plane is shared by the block.  This reduces the steady-state global-memory
+// traffic to approximately one load and one store per cell update.
+__global__ void stencilRange(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                             Real* __restrict__ output,
+                             const std::size_t nx,
+                             const std::size_t ny,
+                             const std::size_t firstZ,
+                             const std::size_t lastZ) {
+    __shared__ Real tile[kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
+
+    const std::size_t rawX = 1 + static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX
+                           + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t rawY = 1 + static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY
+                           + threadIdx.y;
+    const std::size_t x = min(rawX, nx - 1);
+    const std::size_t y = min(rawY, ny - 1);
+    const bool active = rawX < nx - 1 && rawY < ny - 1;
+    const std::size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const std::size_t rowOffset = y * nx + x;
+
+    const std::size_t zStride = static_cast<std::size_t>(gridDim.z) * kZTile;
+    for (std::size_t tileBegin = firstZ
+                                   + static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZTile;
+         tileBegin <= lastZ; tileBegin += zStride) {
+        const std::size_t tileEnd = min(tileBegin + kZTile - 1, lastZ);
+        std::size_t index = tileBegin * plane + rowOffset;
+        Real bottom = input[index - plane];
+        Real center = input[index];
+
+        for (std::size_t z = tileBegin; z <= tileEnd; ++z) {
+            const Real top = input[index + plane];
+            tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 1] = center;
+
+            if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+                tile[threadIdx.y + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+            }
+            if (threadIdx.x == kBlockX - 1) {
+                const std::size_t rightX = min(rawX + 1, nx - 1);
+                tile[threadIdx.y + 1][kBlockX + 1] =
+                    input[z * plane + y * nx + rightX];
+            }
+            if (threadIdx.y == 0) {
+                tile[0][threadIdx.x + 1] = input[index - nx];
+            }
+            if (threadIdx.y == kBlockY - 1) {
+                const std::size_t backY = min(rawY + 1, ny - 1);
+                tile[kBlockY + 1][threadIdx.x + 1] =
+                    input[z * plane + backY * nx + x];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            if (active) {
+                const Real left = tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x];
+                const Real right = tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 2];
+                const Real front = tile[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x + 1];
+                const Real back = tile[threadIdx.y + 2][threadIdx.x + 1];
+                output[index] =
+                    (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            bottom = center;
+            center = top;
+            index += plane;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+void launchStencil(const Real* input, Real* output,
+                   const std::size_t nx, const std::size_t ny,
+                   const std::size_t firstZ, const std::size_t lastZ,
+                   cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (firstZ > lastZ) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t zTiles = (lastZ - firstZ + kZTile) / kZTile;
+    const unsigned int gridZ = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+        std::min<std::size_t>(zTiles, 65535));
+    const dim3 block(kBlockX, kBlockY, 1);
+    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX),
+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY),
+                    gridZ);
+    stencilRange<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(input, output, nx, ny,
+                                             firstZ, lastZ);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+}

+    std::printf("  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\n");
+    std::printf("  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\n");
+    std::printf("  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\n");
+    std::printf("  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\n");

Implemented the hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA stencil without adding source files or changing the `stencil3d` executable name.

Key changes:

- MPI z-slab decomposition with halo exchange.
- CUDA shared-memory tiled stencil with z-axis register reuse.
- Overlapped GPU computation and MPI communication using streams/events.
- Automatic CUDA-aware MPI device transfers when supported; pinned-host fallback otherwise.
- OpenMP-parallel initialization and validation.
- Distributed result gathering with equivalent boundary semantics.
- Required MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA configuration plus optimized GPU architectures in [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/stencil3d_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_hybrid_r4/stencil3d/CMakeLists.txt).
